text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Lucky Umamusume Race is about to
start!
Every New Year, this tradition
attracts many
fleet-footed runners, and
this year is no different.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have a guest runner from
Tracen
Academy this year as well. Let's
give her a huge
round of applause,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha! Rejoice, one and all!
For this
year, the one and only T.M.
Opera O is gracing
the stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How fortuitous you are to be in my
presence, for
today, you shall bear
witness to the moment that
I—blessed as
I am—become the Lucky
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's T.M. Opera O! This might be
the year a
guest runner wins first place!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's not happening. Guest
runners are
always marked by all of the
runners, putting them
at a disadvantage.
Plus they aren't used to the
course...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Besides, she's here again this year! From what I heard, she's been training for this race specifically. Oooh, I just know she's going to give us a good show!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Sorry to rain on the parade, but
you might
as well forfeit, because
victory is going to be
mine again this
year!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, now! She must be quite skillful to
be so
confident!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A worthy opponent takes the stage...
Very well! I
never hold back in a race,
and this one will be no
exception!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sparks fly between the two contenders!
The sharp
crack of the starter pistol
echoes in the chilly
winter air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd
lined up
along the route, the leader of
the pack comes
into view...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
At the head of the pack is last year's
Lucky
Umamusume! Can she hold onto
her lead?! It
looks like T.M. Opera O is
hot on her heels!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I have you now, my worthy opponent!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Ow! My toe...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: Sniff... It hurts, but... I'm fine. So go! You're gonna lose if you don't hurry up and run!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehehe... Haaah ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're worrying about others even in the
midst of
your own pain? What a
beautiful, noble heart you
have!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But fret not. It will take more than a
brief pause
to snatch victory's crown
from my brow!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I leave this child in your capable
hands!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's this?! T.M. Opera O has
taken the
lead! She's broken straight
through the pack with
a powerful burst
of speed!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
And with a huge lead, T.M. Opera O
clinches the
race and becomes this year's
Lucky Umamusume!
We've just witnessed
the ascension of the
Centurial Lucky
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha! Everyone! Say hello
to this
year's Lucky Umamusume—yours
truly!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You were amazing! I wanna be
able to run
just like you someday!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Well, that's a most worthy
and
natural goal, given my outstanding
comeback!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not only did she stop to help a child,
but she
even won the race... I've been
utterly defeated. It
looks like I have a
ways to go...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You put up a valiant fight. A protagonist
shines
only vis-à-vis a worthy rival. You
deserve the
award for the best
supporting role!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
Congratulations, Centurial
Lucky Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all for a high five from
me! Allow
me to share my luck with
everyone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha ha! Haaaaah ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Will you look at that! It's T.M. Opera O!
T.M.
Opera O has made her way to the
front! Aaaaand
the two of them cross the
finish line
simultaneously!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
A performance worthy of the fastest
semi-pro!
She didn't give an inch this
year either, folks! And
coming in at a
close second is T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I was a mere step away from
victory... Is this
yet another ordeal one
must face to become the
top star?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Opera O... You were so cool! I've never
seen
anyone run like you do!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Hehe! If I was able to put a
smile on
your face, then it was all worth
it! I must
commend myself on a job well
done!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I won. I'm this year's Lucky Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your win! Your
display of
strength was worthy of
illuminating my grand
stage!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on... You're too earnest for
your own
good. You helped that kid and
still managed to
make an amazing play
for first place... You're so
cool it almost
hurts.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But of course I am! I'm guessing by
your
words that you too have fallen for
my charms.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think I would be able to capture
hearts even in
defeat... Goodness! Does
my glamour know no
limit?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The title of Lucky Umamusume has
slipped
through T.M. Opera O's fingers,
but her gallantry
ensures that she gleams
brighter than any star in
the sky!
